As a result, when a browser attempts an HTTPS connection to pay.wiapy.com under a filtered AdGuard DNS profile, the TLS handshake fails with a hostname/certificate mismatch (the server at that IP presents a certificate for dns.adguard-dns.com), and our customers are unable to reach the checkout page at all. > > Notably, checkout.wiapy.com — the same underlying platform, same origin infrastructure — is not affected by this block: > > > $ dig `@94.140.14.14` checkout.wiapy.com A +short > 104.26.6.56 > 104.26.7.56 > 172.67.75.140 > This suggests the classification is specific to the pay hostname pattern rather than to our domain or infrastructure as a whole, which is consistent with a false-positive heuristic (payment-related subdomain naming) rather than an actual security concern. > > Official website: https://wiapy.com > > We kindly request a manual review of pay.wiapy.com and removal of this classification if no current malicious activity is found.
